outlook.statement: India remains well positioned to maintain strong economic growth supported by favourable demographics, increasing formalisation, rapid digital adoption and sustained policy reforms. The Company believes long-term growth potential of Indian lending and financial services sector remains strong. Will continue to focus on responsible lending practices, technology-led innovation, prudent risk management and customer-centric solutions.

Efficient Business Model helps to minimise risk and operating cost; Adequate capitalisation to support medium-term growth plans; Expanding revenue streams through strategic partnerships in non-lending financial services and co-lending arrangements; A strengthening economy, increasing levels of formalisation, and rapid digital adoption, opening new avenues for innovation and scale; A growing middle class with evolving and diverse financial needs, creating demand for customised solutions; Growing investor activity is driving demand for loans against securities, creating a strong lending opportunity
